items.docs:
Get current state, lifecycle epochs, balance, and withdrawal credentials for a single validator by its index.

**Cost:** 1 credit per call. Automatically refunded on 4xx/5xx responses.

**Access:** Requires portfolio entitlement.

**Rate limit:** 360 req/min (shared with portfolio bucket)

**Get your API key:** [Dev Portal](https://data.octav.fi)

params.name: pubkey
params.description: 48-byte BLS pubkey, hex-encoded with `0x` prefix (96 hex characters). Case-insensitive.

params.name: index
params.description: Non-negative validator index

params.name: rangeType
params.description: Determines how rangeFrom/rangeTo are interpreted. `timestamp` = Unix seconds (max range 31,536,000 s); `epoch` = beacon epoch numbers (max range 82,125 epochs).

params.name: rangeFrom
params.description: Start of the range (inclusive). Must be ≥ 0 and ≤ rangeTo. Interpreted per rangeType.

params.name: rangeTo
params.description: End of the range (inclusive). Must be ≥ 0. Interpreted per rangeType.

params.name: granularity
params.description: Bucket size for aggregation.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records to return. Max 10.
